description: Spurred by the election annulment and data centre protests, a cross-border network of municipal governments and regional energy authorities begins developing open, auditable AI tools for local service optimisation—focused on grid load balancing, transit routing, and emergency response coordination—using only EU-hosted models below the 45.0 capability threshold. The project avoids central mandates and instead spreads through city-to-city collaboration, framed as regaining agency over essential services.
